mapper.sql: SELECT e.id, e.tenant_id AS tenantId, e.employee_no AS employeeNo, e.employee_name AS employeeName, e.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, d.dept_full_name AS deptFullName, e.position_id AS positionId, p.position_name AS positionName, e.mobile, e.email, e.gender, e.hire_date AS hireDate, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam_user u WHERE u.employee_id = e.id AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.tenant_id = e.tenant_id ) AS boundUserCount, e.employee_status AS employeeStatus, e.remark FROM iam_employee e LEFT JOIN iam_department d ON d.id = e.dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN iam_position p ON p.id = e.position_id AND p.deleted = 0
